snippet.title: Hyper Team Recon ► Release Trailer At Top Hat Studios Tokyo Game Show Showcase
snippet.description:
Hyper Team Recon is an adorable 3D platformer about three aliens and their adventure across Earth! Join Ember, Penny and Lite, three shapeshifting slimes, as they morph into friends and foes alike to copy their forms and gain new abilities! Explore, discover new life forms, and fill your scrapbook! Out now on PC and all consoles.  Out now on Steam, PS4, PS5, XB1, XSX, and Switch.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380990/Hyper_Team_Recon/
